caption: The drawing depicts a single object placed centrally on a plain, lightly textured beige background. The object is a gray skillet or pan with seven round, shallow compartments arranged in a circular flower-like pattern, six circling around one central compartment. Attached to the bottom of this arrangement is a short, rounded handle with a small hole near its end. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray and black, with shading to suggest a metallic texture and some depth within each compartment. The drawing is placed within a rectangular border that is faintly sketched on the background. There are no additional objects, decorations, or text present in the drawing.
title: Muffin Pan
